title: Ghurbat ki inteha hai, na saya na rida hai
body:
Ghurbat ki inteha hai, na saya na rida hai, zahra teri lahad par
Chand patharo'n ne mil kar, mehrooma likh diya hai
zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Teero'n bhari qaba thi, aur qoo'n bhari rida thi
Jo Shaam se bacha tha, Zainab ne rakh diya hai
zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan ki ghutan se, har laashe bekafan se
Abid ne jo sambhala, woh aansu gir pada hai
zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya ye daleel kam hai us ki qamar me qam hai
Kayi bar aasma'n ne, sajda ada kia hai
zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Do pahr dhal rahe hai, qayyaam jal rahe hai
Tasveer Karbala ki, koi bana raha hai
zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere gham ki chand satrain, kaam aayain gi lahad may
Bakhsish Tauqeer ki hai, ye noha jo likha hai
zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Sun kar hawa bhi royi, khud Karbala bhi royi
Khak e rah e Najaf ne, jo marsia parrha hai
zahra teri lahad par
Noha by some party of lahore Writeups - Ghur
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaise lage the pehre rone pe bibiyo ke
bilkul usi tarah ab pehra laga hua hai
Zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ka hai pehra rouze pe shaahe dee'n ke
ummul banee'n ka pehra ab bhi laga hua hai
Zahra teri lahad par
<<DIVIDER>>
jis roz hai chorda shabbir ne madina
us din se aur bhi kuch sannaata hogaya hai
zahra teri lahad par
